8.title: Add CryptoCrew validator
8.message:
CryptoCrew Validators is an Austrian-based Web3 infrastructure provider specializing in secure, transparent validation, IBC relaying and node services. 

Since 2021, we have secured over USD 40 million across 40+ interchain networks and facilitated millions of IBC transactions. Our global network of decentralized bare-metal servers is protected by enterprise-grade security and monitoring, backed by a 24/7 on-call operations team.

As a core protocol contributor we maintain strategic partnerships with foundations and liquid staking protocols. After winning the 2022 Game of Chains Testnet Program on the Cosmos Hub, we now support Interchain Security Solutions and onboarding for consumer chains.

CryptoCrew Validators has received an AAA rating as a Verified Staking Provider on stakingrewards.com: https://www.stakingrewards.com/provider/cryptocrew-validators

9.title: Add Range validator
9.message:
We at Range would like to contribute to the XRPL EVM Mainnet. We've spun up a node and are now looking to take the next step by joining the active validator set. As a team with extensive experience in running blockchain infrastructure, we’re enthusiastic about contributing to the growth and stability of the XRPL EVM ecosystem. We are looking to integrate XRPL EVM into our public explorers and extend support across the tooling and infrastructure we maintain at Range.

If we are allowed to run a mainnet validator, we kindly request a small amount of poa tokens to initiate validator promotion.

10.title: Update Consensus Block Max Gas
10.message: During the genesis phase of mainnet deployments, the consensus parameters were not properly set. As a result, the provided configuration was overridden by default values from CometBFT. We propose to cap the block.max_gas value to 21,000,000, which approximates the gas required for ~1,000 typical Ethereum transactions.

12.title: Add Keplr validator
12.message: Keplr is the largest wallet in the Cosmos ecosystem, trusted by over 2 million users. It also supports EVM and non-EVM chains, including Bitcoin and Starknet. In addition to the core Keplr Wallet, we offer a comprehensive suite of companion products, including Keplr Mobile, the Dashboard, the Multisig Dashboard, and the Validator Dashboard. Beyond our user-facing products, Keplr Infra has been actively operating as a validator on over 20 networks, consistently ranking among the top-tier validators. We also provide high-SLA RPC infrastructure for over 50 Cosmos-based chains and more than 7 EVM chains, dedicated to Keplr users. Our infrastructure spans over 150 servers across 6+ cloud and bare-metal providers — including our own on-premise servers — and has been operated reliably for over three years. It is enterprise-grade, ensuring high availability through finely tailored optimizations and 24/7 monitoring.

16.title: Add Crypto Survivor validator
16.message: Crypto Survivor has been running xrpl evm nodes since devnet launched. Crypto Survivor has been deeply involved in the xrpl community since 2017. Crypto Survivor is a tradesperson who works in the regulatory compliance industry. Crypto Survivor enjoys working with code in his spare time and in addition to maintaining two servers that run multiple instances of testnet and mainnet for the xrpl evm blockchain, he is also building an app using Unity 6 and intends to release it for testing in late 2026.
